_readme: Emotion tags per sticker. Key is "<folder>/<file>" relative to the sticker library; value is the list of emotions it fits. Folders are storage only — retrieval always goes through tags, and one sticker may carry several. Tags must come from _vocabulary below; extend that list when you genuinely need a new emotion.
_vocabulary_note: Keep tags specific. If one sticker is the obvious best answer for a whole tag, that tag is too coarse and should be split, otherwise that sticker gets sent over and over while the rest go unused.
